speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, please describe your wrist pain in detail, including when it started and if it's accompanied by redness or warmth. Also, tell me about the fever and any skin lesions you've noticed.

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Septic arthritis of the left wrist (likely Lyme disease given Minnesota exposure and prior knee involvement).
